name: sql-query
description: SQL database integration — connect to PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, or SQLite to list tables, inspect schemas, and run arbitrary read or write queries. Uses pure-Python drivers so it runs unchanged in the sandbox.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, or SQLite database connection

fields.label: Database Type
fields.helpText: One of: postgres, mysql (also MariaDB), or sqlite.

fields.label: Host
fields.helpText: Server hostname or IP. Leave blank for SQLite.

fields.label: Port
fields.helpText: Defaults to 5432 for postgres and 3306 for mysql.

fields.label: Database (or SQLite file path)
fields.helpText: Database name for postgres/mysql, or the file path for sqlite.

fields.label: Username
fields.helpText: Required for postgres/mysql; ignored for sqlite.

fields.label: Password
fields.helpText: Required for postgres/mysql; ignored for sqlite.

tools.name: sql.list_tables
tools.description: List the tables in the connected database.

tools.name: sql.describe_table
tools.description: Describe a table's columns and their data types.

table.description: Table name (identifier chars only: letters, digits, underscore, dot)

tools.name: sql.run_query
tools.description: Execute an arbitrary SQL statement. SELECTs return columns and rows (capped); other statements return the number of affected rows and are committed. Can read, mutate, or delete data — use with care.

limit.description: Max rows to return for SELECTs (default 500, hard max 1000)
